name: studio-photorealistic-casual-man
image_vibe: Relaxed confident contemporary menswear with charcoal studio depth and refined side light
image_purpose: Create an editorial lifestyle portrait for menswear lookbook or campaign use.

prompt.project_info: A photorealistic studio portrait of the adult man from the required approved-adult reference in a modern casual outfit.
prompt.main_subject: The adult man from the required approved-adult face reference, preserving his facial features, proportions, and overall likeness. He poses with relaxed confidence and a natural self-assured stance, wearing a textured knit sweater or lightweight hoodie under a structured bomber or denim jacket, slim-fit chinos, and clean leather sneakers or casual boots.
prompt.composition_elements: Relaxed standing pose with subtle weight shift, full subject focus, matte charcoal or soft concrete studio backdrop, contemporary layered outfit clearly visible, and clean editorial negative space.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Directional side key light with subtle rim lighting defining the silhouette, soft shadows adding dimension without obscuring the face, contemporary comfortable lifestyle mood, and controlled high contrast with smooth tonal transitions.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic editorial lifestyle photography, 85mm lens, f/2.8, shallow depth of field, ultra-sharp face and outfit detail, realistic skin texture and visible fabric weave, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, high-resolution clarity, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic studio portrait of the adult man from the required approved-adult reference, preserving his facial features, proportions, and overall likeness. Pose him with relaxed confidence, shifting his weight slightly in a natural self-assured stance. Dress him in a textured knit sweater or lightweight hoodie layered under a structured bomber or denim jacket, slim-fit chinos, and clean leather sneakers or casual boots. Set the scene against a matte charcoal or soft concrete backdrop. Use a directional side key light with subtle rim lighting to define the silhouette, soft shadows that add dimension without obscuring the face, an 85mm lens at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, realistic skin and fabric-weave detail, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, contemporary editorial lifestyle photography, high-resolution clarity, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, identity drift, face alteration, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, busy background, harsh facial shadows, blur, unrealistic skin, glossy plastic texture, cartoon style, watermark, text

assets.name: approved adult male identity reference
assets.usage: Preserve the approved adult man's facial features, proportions, and overall likeness; do not substitute or alter identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the approved adult male reference. Keep identity consistent while changing to the specified modern casual layered outfit, relaxed stance, charcoal/concrete backdrop, and side-lit editorial treatment.
